tools.name: list_active_alerts
tools.title: List active storm alerts
tools.description: Return currently active weather/storm alerts published on Bouřkář CZ (level 1–5, description, target city, optional geographic radius). Public data — same info shown on the website.

type.description: Filter by alert type. 'long' = long-range forecast, 'short' = short-range storm. Defaults to all.

tools.name: get_radar_frames
tools.title: Get radar frames
tools.description: Return the current ČHMÚ radar frame timeline for Czechia (past measurements and short-term nowcast). Public data — the same frames shown on the Bouřkář CZ map.

include.description: Which frames to return. Defaults to all.
